posts.content: ComfyUI-See-through: A ComfyUI plugin that wraps [See-through](https://github.com/shitagaki-lab/see-through) — an AI system that decomposes a single anime illustration into manipulatable 2.5D layer-decomposed models with depth ordering, ready for Live2D workflows.

ai.title: ComfyUI-See-through: anime illustration to manipulatable 2.5D layers for Live2D
ai.summary: ComfyUI plugin wrapping See-through AI system that decomposes single anime illustrations into manipulatable 2.5D layer-decomposed models with depth ordering. Output is ready for Live2D workflows.
ai.why_important: Automates the tedious process of separating anime artwork into layers for animation, a critical bottleneck in Live2D production.
ai.learnings: Single illustration can be decomposed into depth-ordered 2.5D layers automatically, eliminating manual layer separation for Live2D.

posts.content: TTS-Audio-Suite: A ComfyUI custom node integration for local multi-engine multi-language Text-to-Speech and Voice Conversion. Supports: RVC, Echo-TTS, Qwen3-TTS, Cozy Voice 3, Step Audio EditX, IndexTTS-2, Chatterbox (classic and multilingual), F5-TTS, Higgs Audio 2, 3, and VibeVoice with unlimited text length, SRT timing, Character support, and many audio tools

ai.title: TTS-Audio-Suite: multi-engine voice synthesis with RVC, F5-TTS, unlimited text length & SRT timing
ai.summary: ComfyUI node supporting 8+ TTS engines and voice conversion with unlimited text length, SRT subtitle timing, and character-based control. Integrates RVC, F5-TTS, Echo-TTS, Qwen3-TTS, and other engines in single workflow.
ai.why_important: Consolidates fragmented TTS ecosystem into one workflow, enabling video editors to generate synced voiceovers with precise timing control.
ai.learnings: Multiple TTS engines can be orchestrated in ComfyUI with SRT timing for frame-accurate audio generation, removing text length limitations.

posts.content: 3DGenStudio: Orchestrate complete 3D generation pipelines — from text-to-image, image editing, mesh generation, UV unwrapping, to texturing — all in a single visual workspace powered by ComfyUI and external APIs.

ai.title: 3DGenStudio: complete text-to-3D pipeline in ComfyUI with mesh, UV, texturing via APIs
ai.summary: Visual workspace orchestrating complete 3D generation pipeline—text-to-image, image editing, mesh generation, UV unwrapping, texturing—within ComfyUI using external APIs. Single unified workflow from prompt to textured 3D asset.
ai.why_important: Eliminates tool-switching across separate 3D generation services by orchestrating the entire pipeline in one visual interface.
ai.learnings: Text-to-3D workflows can be orchestrated end-to-end in ComfyUI by chaining external API calls for mesh, UV, and texture steps.

posts.content: ppt-master: AI turns documents or topics into real, native PowerPoint decks—with native shapes, transitions and animations, data-backed charts and tables on demand, audio narration from speaker notes, and support for your own .pptx templates. · by Hugo He

ai.title: ppt-master: documents to native PowerPoint with shapes, transitions, charts, audio narration
ai.summary: AI system generating native PowerPoint decks from documents or topics with real shapes, transitions, animations, data-backed charts/tables, audio narration from speaker notes, and custom template support. Outputs actual .pptx files, not exported images.
ai.why_important: Produces editable native PowerPoint files instead of static outputs, preserving designer control over final presentation.
ai.learnings: AI can generate native PowerPoint objects (shapes, charts, animations) from text, maintaining full editability in the target format.
